verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a government service that runs a developer platform, so the axis applies. The probe of https://www.uscis.gov/llms.txt returned HTTP 403, so no readable agent-oriented docs index was available. The Torch developer docs (Case Status and FOIA APIs) are conventional human-facing API onboarding material, not agent-oriented documentation.
